Initiative: Shorten and rehearse the demonstration path
ExpectedOutcome: Complete the primary demonstration within eight minutes while retaining two minutes for questions.
SuccessMeasure: Two consecutive rehearsals complete in 480 seconds or less without exposing sensitive information.

ExpectedOutcome: Confirm legal, privacy, data-classification, encryption, retention and incident-response requirements before processing real resident information.
SuccessMeasure: Approved privacy impact assessment and production security review.

Initiative: Deploy through a production HTTPS platform
ExpectedOutcome: Replace localhost Flask hosting with monitored, backed-up and resilient HTTPS hosting.
SuccessMeasure: TLS enforced; health monitoring active; backup and recovery test passed.

ExpectedOutcome: Use managed identity or certificate authentication with credentials held in a managed vault.
SuccessMeasure: No production client secret stored in local environment files; rotation procedure tested.

ExpectedOutcome: Forward Entra and application events to protected centralized monitoring with retention and alerting.
SuccessMeasure: Required events searchable in the SIEM; retention and alert tests passed.

ExpectedOutcome: Use Conditional Access, stronger session controls and licensed governance capabilities.
SuccessMeasure: Required licence approved; Conditional Access tested in report-only and enforced modes.

ExpectedOutcome: Reduce unattended-session and residual-browser-data risks on shared devices.
SuccessMeasure: Managed shared-device profile, automatic browser-data clearing and sign-out procedure validated.

ExpectedOutcome: Use Temporary Access Pass or another approved passwordless onboarding method.
SuccessMeasure: New worker completes secure onboarding without manually transferring a reusable temporary password.

ExpectedOutcome: Generate approved lifecycle events from HR data instead of manually prepared CSV files.
SuccessMeasure: Approved workforce event creates a validated dry-run plan without manual transcription.

ExpectedOutcome: Detect differences among workforce status, Entra groups and care-application roles.
SuccessMeasure: Scheduled comparison reports unauthorized drift and produces zero unexplained differences.

ExpectedOutcome: Replace the manual review process with scheduled reviewer decisions and verified remediation.
SuccessMeasure: Quarterly review completes with recorded reviewer, decision, remediation and verification.

ExpectedOutcome: Validate recovery from application, database and monitoring failures.
SuccessMeasure: Recovery exercise meets approved recovery-time and recovery-point objectives.
